about.menuDesc: Why we built it, what we hope reaches you — read again whenever it feels heavy.
about.title: The Meaning Flow story
about.whyTitle:
You're not lazy.
Just an engine that runs on different fuel.
about.whyBody: This is a todo app made to help IN-type people start and finish. For those who can't start because perfection blocks them. For those whose brains have a booster and never stop generating ideas. We wanted to make a place where you can flow without whipping yourself.
about.promise1Body: No streaks, no "X completed this month" counters. The 70% completion button is designed more prominently than 100%. "Today this is enough."
about.promise2Body: Your journal and thought vault — only you can read them (Row Level Security). Garden posts are anonymous. Operators don't read your text directly either.
about.inTraitsIntro: If even one of these feels like you, this app may reach you.
about.dualSelfBody: Solo you and Social you — both are you. MBTI here isn't a diagnostic tool, just a starting point for conversation. Identity isn't fixed; it flows. You can pick again anytime in Settings.
